officialTitle: First-line nivolumab plus ipilimumab combined with two cycles of chemotherapy in patients with non-small-cell lung cancer (CheckMate 9LA): an international, randomised, open-label, phase 3 trial

design.sampleSizeSourceQuote: Between Aug 24, 2017, and Jan 30, 2019, 1150 patients were enrolled and 719 (62·5%) randomly assigned to nivolumab plus ipilimumab with two cycles of chemotherapy (n=361 [50%]) or four cycles of chemotherapy alone (n=358 [50%]).
design.notes: Stratified by histology, sex and PD-L1 expression.

clinicalQuestion: Does adding a limited (two-cycle) course of chemotherapy to nivolumab plus ipilimumab improve overall survival over chemotherapy alone in first-line advanced NSCLC?

pico.population: Treatment-naive stage IV or recurrent NSCLC, ECOG PS 0–1
pico.intervention: Nivolumab plus ipilimumab with two cycles of histology-based platinum-doublet chemotherapy

arms.label: Nivolumab + ipilimumab + 2 cycles chemotherapy
arms.regimen: Nivolumab plus ipilimumab plus two cycles of histology-based platinum doublet
arms.dosing: Nivolumab 360 mg IV every 3 weeks plus ipilimumab 1 mg/kg IV every 6 weeks, with chemotherapy every 3 weeks for two cycles
arms.doseSourceQuote: nivolumab (360 mg intravenously every 3 weeks) plus ipilimumab (1 mg/kg intravenously every 6 weeks) combined with histology-based, platinum doublet chemotherapy (intravenously every 3 weeks for two cycles; experimental group)

publications.title: First-line nivolumab plus ipilimumab combined with two cycles of chemotherapy in patients with non-small-cell lung cancer (CheckMate 9LA): an international, randomised, open-label, phase 3 trial.
publications.label: Interim analysis and longer follow-up

outcomes.sourceQuote: At the pre-planned interim analysis (median follow-up 9·7 months [IQR 6·4-12·8]), overall survival in all randomly assigned patients was significantly longer in the experimental group than in the control group (median 14·1 months [95% CI 13·2-16·2] vs 10·7 months [9·5-12·4]; hazard ratio [HR] 0·69 [96·71% CI 0·55-0·87]; p=0·00065).

With 3·5 months longer median follow-up (median 13·2 months [IQR 6·4-17·0]), median overall survival was 15·6 months (95% CI 13·9-20·0) in the experimental group versus 10·9 months (9·5-12·6) in the control group (HR 0·66 [95% CI 0·55-0·80]).

safety.description: Serious treatment-related adverse events of any grade
safety.sourceQuote: Serious treatment-related adverse events of any grade occurred in 106 (30%) patients in the experimental group and 62 (18%) in the control group.

Seven (2%) deaths in the experimental group (acute kidney failure, diarrhoea, hepatotoxicity, hepatitis, pneumonitis, sepsis with acute renal insufficiency, and thrombocytopenia; one patient each) and six (2%) deaths in the control group

strengths: Randomised phase III with OS primary endpoint

clinicalImplications.text: Established nivolumab plus ipilimumab with two cycles of chemotherapy as a first-line option for advanced NSCLC without targetable drivers.

tumourBoardPearl.text: The two-cycle chemotherapy 'bridge' was designed to provide early disease control while dual checkpoint blockade takes effect.

curation.notes: All numbers transcribed from the PubMed abstract of PMID 33476593. Interim OS HR reported with 96.71% CI.
